preconditions.description: The number of operators is between 1 and 100, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each operator is either 'typedef A B' or 'typeof A'
preconditions.description: Each operator is either a type definition or a type retrieval.

preconditions.expression: A and B are non-empty lines of no more than 20 lowercase Latin letters
preconditions.description: The type names A and B are non-empty and have a maximum length of 20 characters.

preconditions.expression: A does not contain asterisks or ampersands
preconditions.description: The type A does not contain any asterisks or ampersands.

preconditions.expression: The number of asterisks and ampersands in A and B does not exceed 10
preconditions.description: The combined number of asterisks and ampersands in A and B does not exceed 10.

postconditions.expression: For every typeof operator, print the type that the operator returned
postconditions.description: The output must include the type returned by each typeof operator based on the sequence of typedef operations.

invariants.description: The errtype is special and behaves as a constant with the properties defined.
Any attempt to dereference a void type results in errtype.

invariants.expression: typedef redefines types, with the last definition taking precedence
invariants.description: The typedef operator redefines types, with the latest definition overwriting previous ones.
The dereference operation has lower priority compared to the pointer operation, and thus &T * is always equivalent to T.
